identity.title: Verify Gray BGR BGRA and 16-bit input meaning separation

origin.summary: 2D-029 requires a source and contract comparison of UI display loading versus Runner inspection input for Gray/BGR/BGRA/16-bit images.

state.current_summary: 2D-029 is complete. The sample-check Runner now preserves source depth for preflight, rejects non-8-bit or undecodable inspection files before calculation, and continues supported 8-bit Gray/BGR/BGRA through the existing BitmapImageConverter. ImageCanvas 16-bit downscale and BGRA alpha removal remain display-only and are covered by a separate contract.

objective.summary: Make the current UI display versus Runner inspection input contract explicit for Gray, BGR, BGRA, and 16-bit images, preserving supported pixel meaning and rejecting unsupported inspection depth before calculation.
constraints: Reuse BitmapImageConverter for Runner input and CanvasImageLoader for display input; do not add a new normalization service or algorithm.
Do not infer 16-bit inspection support or silently downscale Runner inputs; display conversion remains a display-only boundary.
Use isolated evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: Runner conversion preserves supported 8-bit Gray/BGR/BGRA pixel values and channel meaning, while a 16-bit Bitmap input is rejected explicitly before a Mat is returned.
The ImageCanvas display loader's 16-bit downscale and BGRA-to-BGR behavior is proven as display-only, with no claim that the inspection Runner accepts or normalizes those values.
Focused Debug/Release contracts and documentation record the two owners, call paths, supported/unsupported formats, and the unverified WPF/runtime boundary.

evidence.observation: Debug executable contract passed all cases: 8-bit Gray/BGR/BGRA pixel meaning, 16-bit Runner rejection before calculation, damaged decode rejection, and display-only 16-bit/alpha mapping.
Release executable contract passed the same Gray/BGR/BGRA, 16-bit rejection, damaged decode, and display-only mapping cases.
The existing converter regression passed 5/5 in Debug and Release. Preview/Run/Reopen regression passed Mean, Blob, Contour, Matching, and Line in both configurations.
The report, stable contract, and handoff record the Runner/display owners, call paths, supported/unsupported formats, preflight change, D: evidence, and the unverified WPF/runtime boundary.

events.summary: Keep BitmapImageConverter and CanvasImageLoader as their existing owners. Add only a source-depth/decode preflight in VisionPipelineSampleCheckService so display-only 16-bit/alpha mapping cannot silently become Runner input normalization.
All 2D-029 criteria are satisfied by Debug/Release input-format contracts, existing converter and Preview/Run/Reopen regressions, and documented owner/runtime boundaries.
